newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 17.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 17.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Light rains and wind gusts along the states of Colima, Michoacan, Guerrero and in the Gulf of Tehuantepec. Winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
Clear skies and hot with some strong winds and possible rains. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to six feet high.
Cloudy with medium to strong rains along the coasts of Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama.
Tropical storm off the coast of Nicaragua heading west at 10 knots. A separate storm spotted off coast of Venezuela moving west at speed of 10 knots.
In Mexico's Yucatan and Quintana Roo hot and partly cloudy with some rains. Winds 10 to 15 knots and waves three to six feet high.
